title: The Value of Measuring Trust in AI – A Socio-Technical System Perspective
benchmark_measurement: This paper is a theoretical/perspective piece and does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements related to faith or religion. It discusses frameworks for measuring trust in AI.
findings: The paper does not discuss or analyze any aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on the methodology of measuring trust in AI systems from a socio-technical perspective.
